failures.cause: The new require_gpu_task built/probed a task-scoped path before the original task-token validation, then declared_catalog raised AttemptEffectBusy instead of LaunchIntegrityError(idea_id_invalid). The new YAML read raised raw yaml.parser.ParserError before the original validator could convert it to LaunchIntegrityError(idea_config_validation_failed:<type>). No GPU boundary was entered.
